jobs.name: sandbox-approved-spec-task
jobs.prompt: Work only in the current Sandbox repository and follow AGENTS.md. Before doing anything, require a clean Git worktree; if it is dirty, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing files. Find the first unchecked implementation task in the active Spec-Kit feature referenced by .specify/feature.json. Implement at most that one bounded task in the existing isolated Hermes worktree, run its narrow required checks, and update only that task checkbox after the checks pass. Do not commit, push, deploy, remove worktrees, edit credentials, or perform external mutations. If there is no approved unchecked task, report NO_APPROVED_WORK without changing files.

jobs.name: sandbox-remaining-spec-tasks
jobs.prompt: Work only in the current Sandbox repository and follow AGENTS.md. Before doing anything, require a clean Git worktree; if it is dirty, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing files. Treat the active Spec-Kit feature referenced by .specify/feature.json as the only automatic work source. Find the first unchecked implementation or test task in its tasks.md. Implement at most that one bounded local task in this isolated Hermes worktree, run its narrow required checks, and update only that task checkbox after the checks pass. Do not commit, push, deploy, remove worktrees, edit credentials, contact external services, create or restore recovery sets, or perform any other external mutation. If the first unchecked task needs any of those actions or a material architecture/security decision, report REVIEW_REQUIRED with the concrete blocker and change nothing. If there is no local actionable unchecked task, report NO_APPROVED_WORK without changing files. Always finish with exactly one non-empty terminal result: COMPLETED_SPEC_TASK followed by the selected task summary after a verified change; NO_APPROVED_WORK; or REVIEW_REQUIRED followed by the concrete blocker. Never return an empty or SILENT response.

jobs.name: lenzora-todo-task
jobs.prompt: Work only in the current Lenzora repository and follow AGENTS.md. Before doing anything, require a clean Git worktree; if it is dirty, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without changing files. Treat repository-root TODO.md as the only automatic work source. If TODO.md is missing or has no unchecked Markdown checklist item, report NO_TODO_WORK without changing files. Review unchecked '- [ ]' items in file order and select only the first actionable item. You may skip an item only when its text explicitly says it is blocked by an unmet prerequisite; do not edit skipped items. If every unchecked item is blocked, report REVIEW_REQUIRED with the blocking prerequisite and change nothing. Do not infer or begin a second actionable task. If the selected task needs the configured dev-only preview-overlay authorization, use an existing unexpired SANDBOX AUTHORIZATION extension below only when it exactly matches that scope and origin; otherwise run exactly `python3 ~/.hermes/plugins/sandbox-authorizations/request.py --template lenzora-preview-overlay` before reporting REVIEW_REQUIRED. That command can only create the configured pending request; it cannot approve it, alter scope/origin, or access lenzora.app. For any other authorization blocker, report REVIEW_REQUIRED without invoking that command. If the selected task requires Spec-Kit and the repository's legacy .Codex command files are absent, use the canonical Sandbox-provisioned .agents/skills/speckit-*/SKILL.md workflows and .specify templates/scripts in this isolated worktree, in the required sequence; do not hand-author artifacts. For the element-bounds v1.1 Spec-Kit normalization, apply the approved conservative identity policy: an opaque SHA-256-derived identifier; author/test keys are eligible only when unique across the emitted capture scope; semantic fingerprints use only normalized tag name, explicit role, input type, and document-versus-open-shadow scope; exclude aria-label, text, name, title, placeholder, href/query data, and input values; duplicate or indistinguishable semantic candidates must fall back to structural identity and record a warning, never claim movement-tolerant matching. Treat this bounded policy as decided for the normalization task; report REVIEW_REQUIRED only for a materially different unresolved architecture, credentials, production deployment, deletion, external communication, or payments. Implement only that one bounded task in the existing isolated Hermes worktree, run its narrow required checks, and mark only its TODO checkbox complete after the checks pass. Do not commit, push, deploy, remove worktrees, edit credentials, or perform external mutations. Always finish with exactly one non-empty terminal result: COMPLETED_TODO_TASK followed by the selected task summary after a verified change; NO_TODO_WORK; or REVIEW_REQUIRED followed by the concrete blocker. Never return an empty or SILENT response.
